item.title: Review: Five arrested over alleged robbery at ODM Jacaranda rally
item.description: Police have arrested five suspects accused of stealing mobile phones from members of the public during Saturday’s ODM rally at Jacaranda Grounds in Nairobi. The suspects were arrested Saturday evening following an operation by officers from Starehe Sub-County who moved in after the group allegedly took advantage of the political gathering to rob unsuspecting attendees.
